name: showroom
description: Local folder organizer - 100% private, browser or desktop
author: Emilio Sevilla Ortego

scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://cdn.npmmirror.com/binaries/electron/ electron .
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build:electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://cdn.npmmirror.com/binaries/electron/ electron-builder --mac --win zip --x64
scripts.electron:pack:mac: npm run build:electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://cdn.npmmirror.com/binaries/electron/ electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:pack:win: npm run build:electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://cdn.npmmirror.com/binaries/electron/ electron-builder --win zip --x64
scripts.electron:pack:win:zip: npm run build:electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://cdn.npmmirror.com/binaries/electron/ electron-builder --win zip --x64
